properties.rationale: Same disposition as its sibling cap:fork-alternatives (the user's standing 2026-07-23 call, extended 2026-07-24 to the rung-3 capability captured in this session): cap:revise-trigger is `planned` and deliberately unbuilt — its threshold question ("how much evidence counts as enough to re-open a road") is explicitly left open until the detector can be run against real history, because fixing a number before there is anything to calibrate it on would be a guess wearing a decision's clothes.
